items.heading: "What Will You Even Do
items.text: "What will you even do with a BA in English literature" is the wrong question, because it assumes content writing is the only real answer. It is the loudest answer, not the only one.

items.heading: Before the Job List, IT
items.text: Before the job list, it helps to name what three or four years of close-reading dense texts, writing argument-based essays, and defending an interpretation under scrutiny actually gave you. These are transferable, paid skills, not soft trivia.

Graduates who want private-sector income and structured, less creative writing work. Ranks third for its clear, stackable skill-compounding.
Technical writer pay in India commonly runs Rs 4.4 LPA and above at entry, climbing faster with a specific tool or domain skill layered on top.
Graduates who want to stay closest to books and manuscripts, and enjoy line-by-line craft work.
Entry-level editorial assistant roles commonly start around Rs 2-3.5 LPA in Indian publishing houses. Growth is real but slow without a specialised publishing credential.

items.heading: Do You Want to Stay
items.text: Do you want to stay inside literature, or use it as a base for something adjacent. Publishing, academia, and creative writing keep you working directly with literary text. Law, civil services, corporate communications, and ELT abroad use the reading, writing, and reasoning skill the degree builds, but apply it to a different subject entirely.

items.heading: Do You Want a Government
items.text: Do you want a government-gated door or a private-sector door. Civil services and NET-based teaching run through structured government exams and fixed vacancy or funding cycles. Publishing, content writing, corporate communications, translation, and ELT abroad run through private hiring, portfolios, and certifications instead.

items.heading: Can You Commit to Another
items.text: Can you commit to another degree, or do you need to start earning sooner. Academia and a Publishing Diploma effectively require another 1-2 years of study. Content writing and a CELTA certification are the two paths on this list that get you into paid work fastest.
